The house

A salt-bleached house a short walk from the water, with a garden of juniper and a pool the colour of the sea.

Can Talaia is a low, white house on the edge of Es Pujols, arranged around a courtyard and a pool. The interiors are simple and cool; the terraces are where the house really lives.

Five bedrooms, a long kitchen and a shaded outdoor table make it an easy base for a Formentera summer.
